description: Details required by Conditions 2-D (Detailed plans, sections and elevation drawings of the plant and Screening), 2-E (Details of the proposed samples for the plant screen), 2-F (Position, specification, and details of all mechanical ventilation), and 2-G (Means of reducing the transmission of noise from the premises), of Planning Permission PP/24/03430 (Variation of Condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission PP/22/04418 (Replacement of windows, repair of facade, erection of plant enclosures, associated engineering and ancillary works including installation of new and removal/rearrangement of existing plant) for amendment to approved drawings to enable a widening of the proposed plant enclosures at level 2 and level 8.)
